summary: Both backend (18/18 pytest) and frontend (organizer create → control panel advance/previous → parent manual-code live view) end-to-end flows verified working. Backend strips passcode on public reads, returns 401 on wrong passcode, 404 on unknown, clamps current_index at boundaries, and PUT /events resets index to 0. Frontend home → organizer → create (LOAD SAMPLE → START MEET) → control panel renders QR + meet code (e.g. UBNQJT) + Race X of N + ADVANCE/PREVIOUS work. Parent flow via HAVE A CODE link → /scan?manual=1 → enter code → /live shows NOW RACING, UP NEXT (2 races), and FULL SCHEDULE with star (favorite) icons next to each race.

issues: TextInput on manual code screen has no data-testid (only one <input>, found by index). Add testID='manual-code-input' and testID='submit-code-button' for robust e2e testing.

Favorite star buttons have no testID matching a queryable pattern (no [data-testid^='favorite-'] found). Add testID='favorite-<raceId>' for each star button so favorites can be exercised in automation.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'SafeAreaView has been deprecated...use react-native-safe-area-context instead.' Non-blocking but worth fixing across screens.

action_items: Add testID to the manual code TextInput on /scan and to its submit (GO TO MEET) button.
Add testID to each favorite (star) Pressable in live view, e.g. testID={`favorite-${race.id}`}.
Optional: migrate SafeAreaView to react-native-safe-area-context to silence deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is clean (~250 lines), uses async motor, excludes Mongo _id via doc.pop('_id'), uses env vars only, validates input via Pydantic, returns proper 400/401/404 codes.
api.ts properly uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with no hardcoded URLs.

Passcode is passed as a query-string parameter in the router URL (control?passcode=...) — minor security note: ok for a public preview demo but consider keeping it only in component state/AsyncStorage to avoid leaking via referrers/history; not a blocker for MVP.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (home, organizer create, control advance/previous, parent live)

seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_-prefixed meets via API and one TEST Summer Invite via UI (code UBNQJT). Safe to leave or sweep.
